about:
D5 Design & Metal Fabrication was founded in 2012 in Chicago, Illinois. The company operates as a full-service design and metal fabrication shop serving the Chicago area and beyond.

The shop specializes in Division 5 metals, a category that includes structural metal framing, metal decking, and related components. It provides architectural metal design and fabrication along with CNC plasma cutting. Its project portfolio ranges from simple masonry support angles and lintels to intricate canopies and helical stairs, indicating a capacity for both structural and ornamental metalwork.

D5 serves commercial, residential, and government clients, handling projects of any scale. The company emphasizes that no project is too big or too small, working with general contractors, architects, and building owners on custom metal fabrications. Typical projects include stair systems, canopy structures, and miscellaneous steel supports.

The firm differentiates itself through its full-service approach, combining design and fabrication under one roof, and its focus on Division 5 metal specialties. This integrated capability allows it to move from concept to finished installation without outsourcing core processes. The company's stated goal is to provide clients with a quality product they can be proud of.
